label: Crooked Mile
note: Races 4 and 5: the crag crew's course (the fourth rung), on the far side of the planet out of Cragfall village. From the start it runs down into the basin south of the village (c1, on the tunnel's line so you go in straight) and through a tunnel under two peaks (course_mountains crooked_mile in content/look/desert_landforms.json, cut along this course's legs: c2 the west portal, c3 halfway, c4 the east portal), out along the tunnel's line onto its own level pad (c5), then into a dry wash and three switchback rows up and down its length, each turn two square corners (c6 to c11) so there is no cutting across, out at the wash's south corner (c12) and back to the start. The wash is choked with rock: four tall spires and six short hoodoos moved here from round the planet stand between the rows and inside the turns, and boulders moved off the rest of the planet are strewn on and round the track (the boulders' `courses` block), leaving a lane down the legs themselves. clear_m is smaller than the other courses' so the rocks crowd the track. `floors`: the wash, the start and the turn out of the tunnel are level ground (RaceCourse.floor_sites). Same shape as hoodoo_run.json (read its note: the course is straight legs between the gates); everything is plateau x,z (the far side's map is stretched across several times over, so these numbers were laid out in metres on the ground and converted, and the legs are straight on the ground); no track beast.
